name: BL-010 criteria, addendum 1: Monday-open repricing (Phase 2 step 7)
adds_to: bl010_criteria.json - unchanged; this file only adds a step that file does not have
rule: Committed before the step ran. Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason.
reason: Owner decision 2026-10-05: a new Broad run keeps signal_delay 0, and Phase 2 measures the cost of trading at Monday's open instead of Friday's close. The flag level is fixed here so that 'does the gap matter' is not decided after seeing it.

monday_open_repricing.what: Each of the six Phase 2 configs re-run with signal_delay 0 (the default for a new Broad run; everything else as searched: Rs 2 lakh, itemised costs, pre-tax). The same decisions are then replayed twice from raw data: filled at the signal week's last close, as the backtest assumes, and filled at the next trading day's open. The difference between the two is the result.
monday_open_repricing.flag_applies_to: any one of the six delay-0 runs
monday_open_repricing.if_flagged: Broad gets a Monday-fill execution option and results are quoted on it; a week's signal delay is not the fix
monday_open_repricing.reference_only: The same pair on the as-searched (signal_delay 1) runs. Reported, never judged.

revised: 2026-10-05, before any run of this step: the first wording did not say which signal delay the six configs run at. The owner's question is about delay 0, so that is what is measured; nothing else changed.
